in_arabic.name: اليشا
in_arabic.meaning: اسم غير مشتق من القرآن ولكنه يحمل معاني جميلة

in_urdu.name: الیشا
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام جو اسلامی ثقافت میں استعمال ہوتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: الیشا ایک ایسا نام ہے جو جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں مقبول ہے۔ اس کا مطلب خوبصورت یا خوش کردار فرد سے ہو سکتا ہے۔ یہ نام براہ راست قرآن کریم سے نہیں لیا گیا ہے، لیکن اس کی جڑیں عربی زبان میں ہیں جو اسلامی ثقافت میں گہرا تعلق رکھتی ہے۔

data.cultural_impact: The name Alesha is associated with the Islamic cultural belief of the significance of the night hours. In many Muslim societies, night hours are considered more virtuous for prayer and spiritual reflection, as the Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "The best prayers after the obligatory prayers are those performed in the night." (Sahih Muslim 1176) This cultural value is reflected in the name, making Alesha a unique and beautiful name for a girl born during the night.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spiritual tradition, the night is believed to be a time of increased spiritual connection to Allah. The name Alesha, meaning 'night-born', carries this spiritual significance. The Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "Our Lord descends every night to the nearest heaven when one-third of the night remains, and He forgives more than the chest of the earth can contain." (Ibn Majah 1171). Thus, the name Alesha can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual potential that comes with the night, and a blessing for a little girl who was born during those hours.
